gaps: Pre-2006 (NAIA era) not covered: Biola's online news archive for XC/T&F begins in 2006 and no pre-2007 NAIA poll archive was reachable.

NAIA XC 2007-2014: most weekly NAIA poll releases (naia.org/cstv) are dead on the live site and Wayback was throttled; rows for these seasons are mostly Biola-news mentions (week numbers approximate, points unknown). Men's XC 2007, 2009, 2010, 2012, 2014 had no ranking found (2010 story says men 'failed to receive votes'; 2014 men 'enter unranked').
NAIA XC 2011 women's and 2012 men's polls: only partial (women 2011 two mentions; men 2012 none).
NAIA XC 2015 weeks 2-6 and NAIA final/post-championship polls 2007-2014 not found as primary documents.

2017 and 2018 XC/T&F: Biola was a provisional NCAA DII member and ineligible for NCAA DII national/regional rankings (confirmed by 7/12/2019 Biola release); no NAIA rankings after leaving NAIA (dropped from 2017 NAIA women's XC preseason poll).
2020 XC season cancelled (COVID); 2020 outdoor T&F cancelled.
NAIA Track & Field: USTFCCCA NAIA computer rankings only exist from 2014 indoor onward; no NAIA T&F team polls found for 2006-2013. Biola men never appeared in the NAIA T&F top 25 (2014-2017).

NCAA DII Track & Field regional TFRI (West) not captured: USTFCCCA's polls-rankings hub is behind a bot challenge. National TFRI checked for 2020-2025 indoor/outdoor via each season's final week-by-week table; 2026 indoor/outdoor TFRI pages not located (URL scheme changed).

NCAA DII XC post-championship FINAL poll values come from the week-by-week table's FINAL column (no separate page fetched). 2019 women's post-regional FINAL regional ranking not shown (not in West top 10 after Week 2).
2026 XC season in progress: national Week 1 and regional Week 2 are the latest captured (as of 2026-09-29).
